panels.title: Request Rate
panels.description: Total HTTP requests per second served by the key server.

panels.title: Error Rate
panels.description: Share of responses with a 4xx/5xx status code over the dashboard window.

panels.title: p99 Latency
panels.description: 99th percentile request handling latency across all routes.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the key server process last started.

panels.title: Memory (RSS)
panels.description: Resident memory used by the key server process.

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: Number of goroutines currently running.

panels.title: Request Rate by Route
panels.description: Requests per second broken down by matched route.

panels.title: Request Rate by Status
panels.description: Requests per second broken down by HTTP status code.

panels.title: Request Latency Quantiles
panels.description: p50 / p90 / p99 request handling latency across all routes (from histogram buckets).

panels.title: Latency Distribution
panels.description: Heatmap of request latency across histogram buckets over time.

panels.title: Average Latency by Route
panels.description: Mean request latency per route (rate of _sum / rate of _count).

panels.title: 4xx / 5xx Errors by Route
panels.description: Rate of error responses (status 4xx/5xx) per route.

panels.title: Per-Route Breakdown
panels.description: Request rate, p99 latency and error rate for each route (over the dashboard window).

panels.title: CPU Usage
panels.description: CPU seconds consumed per second (1.0 = one full core).

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Process resident memory and Go heap usage.

panels.title: Goroutines & Threads
panels.description: Live goroutines and OS threads created by the runtime.

panels.title: Network I/O
panels.description: Bytes received and transmitted by the process over the network.

panels.title: Open File Descriptors
panels.description: Open file descriptors versus the process limit.

panels.title: GC Pause (p99) & Frequency
panels.description: 99th percentile stop-the-world GC pause; watch for growth under load.

panels.title: Heap Allocation Rate
panels.description: Bytes allocated per second on the heap — the main driver of GC pressure. Steady = healthy; sustained growth means more work churning memory.

panels.title: GC Frequency & Pause
panels.description: Garbage-collection cycles per second, alongside worst-case stop-the-world pause. Rising frequency with flat pauses is normal under load.

panels.title: Heap vs GC Goal
panels.description: Live heap versus the size at which the next GC triggers. A healthy service sawtooths below the goal; a steadily climbing floor is the classic memory-leak signature.

panels.title: Go Version
panels.description: Go runtime version the key server was built with.

panels.title: GOMAXPROCS
panels.description: Max OS threads executing Go code simultaneously (effective CPU parallelism).

panels.title: GOGC
panels.description: Heap growth target percentage before a GC is triggered (default 100).

panels.title: GOMEMLIMIT
panels.description: Soft memory limit for the runtime. A value near 8 EiB means no limit is set.

panels.title: Key Resolution Outcomes
panels.description: Rate of remote key resolutions by outcome (cache_fresh/cache_cooldown/origin_success/notary_success/all_failed_*/archive_served).

panels.title: Local Serve Ratio
panels.description: Fraction of resolutions served from our store (cache_fresh + cache_cooldown + archive_served) vs. all resolutions.

panels.title: Archive Serves
panels.description: Rate of requests answered from the frozen archive of a gone server (outcome=archive_served).

panels.title: Origin Fetch Latency
panels.description: Latency of direct key fetches from origin servers (p50/p95/p99).

panels.title: Notary Fetch Latency (p95 by notary)
panels.description: Notary lag: p95 latency of key fetches from each trusted notary.

panels.title: Origin Fetch Rate by Result
panels.description: Rate of direct origin fetch attempts by result (success/failure).

panels.title: Notary Fetch Rate by Result
panels.description: Rate of notary fetch attempts by notary and result (success/failure).

panels.title: Known Servers
panels.description: Total remote servers we hold a record for (direct + notary + unreachable).

panels.title: Reached Directly
panels.description: Servers whose keys we last fetched straight from the origin.

panels.title: Reached via Notary
panels.description: Servers whose origin was unreachable, so their keys came from a trusted notary.

panels.title: Unreachable
panels.description: Servers neither the origin nor any notary could resolve (negative-cache entries).

panels.title: Known Servers by Reachability
panels.description: Cached remote servers, stacked by how their keys were last obtained. Stacked total is every server we know of: direct + notary + unreachable.
